dict.string: Scan connection codes for your computer and Home Assistant. Codes are processed on this device.
Hold three fingers to speak instructions to your Screenpunk agent.
Screenpunk transcribes your instructions so your agent can create and change screens. Speech may be processed by Apple when on-device recognition is unavailable.
Find your computer during agent setup and connect to services you approve, such as Home Assistant and Google TV.
Show your location when you request it in a screen’s map.
